triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: Running the M0 smoke checker against experiments/multi-model-ablation M0 artifacts passes and m0-status.md marks the requested Research M0 milestones with pass/blocker states while explicitly recording providerCallsMade=false and phase1OrPhase2CellsRun=false.
acceptanceBindings.note: Full M0 readiness acceptance is satisfied only by the M0 smoke artifacts, checker pass, and explicit no Phase 1/2 boundary; no single host audit can satisfy it alone.
